name: Soyuz-16
about: Soyuz-16 (1974-096A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TM), launched 1974 Dec  2. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1974 Dec  4), held fixed
